verdict.rationale: A global hotkey or quake-style dropdown window is a fair axis for a terminal emulator like Warp, but nothing in the evidence pack documents either. The only shortcut cited is the in-app Conversations menu (⌘+Y), which is not a system-wide summon hotkey. The appearance docs mention pane behavior but nothing about a hotkey window.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can summon the terminal instantly with a global hotkey or quake-style dropdown window
